steps.name: Simulation — Pass 1 (RNG + Edge)
steps.detail: scored against the COMMITTED artifact (pinned by SIMULATION_SHA256, reconciled in Step 19) — this step is deterministic, not a fresh experiment; artifact schema v1, verifier schema v2; 3 screens Bonferroni-corrected to α_screen=3.333e-3 so THOSE THREE have a family-wise level of α=0.01. draw uniformity chi²=91.828 df=99 at n=2000000 (pinned 2000000) → recomputed p=0.6826, two-sided: rejected if p<1.67e-3 (non-uniform) or p>0.998333 (TOO uniform for a 2000000-draw sample) (ok); serial at n=200000 (pinned 200000): lag1Z=1.208 == lag1·√n (reconciled) < zCrit 2.9352 (the two-sided normal quantile at α_screen, AS 241), runsP=0.1284 (derived from runsZ=-1.520) ≥ α_screen; schema 1: runs cell counts absent, so runsZ is NOT re-derivable here — it is a raw statistic bounded only by its own two-sided screen (L1). A z of exactly 0 is an ordinary outcome and is not treated as evidence of anything; stored zCritical 2.576236081309571 is a schema-1 field at the uncorrected α and is not read; the threshold APPLIED is 2.9351994688667054 (ok); effective-edge 9/9 bands within 5·SE+1e-4 of theory at n=2000000 (recomputed), band set identical to the 9 canonical bands, 0 row(s) whose derived fields disagree with re-derivation, 9/9 row(s) whose simulatedRTP IS bit-for-bit the return their integer win count reconstructs to (the producer's own per-win accumulation, replayed) and 0 row(s) whose simulatedRTP is the return of NO integer win count; RTP convergence 7 points at the pinned marks (ok), ends at n=20000000 (pinned 20000000), finalRTP=98.977% == last plotted point (reconciled) vs 99.00%, Δ=1.0398·SE within the 5·SE band; ALL 7 plotted standard errors RECOMPUTED from (n, rtp, wins, m) and compared exactly, win counts 524/5026/50090/499725/2499794/5000313/9997675 (reconstructed) cumulatively consistent and 7/7 of them reconstructing bit-for-bit to the published RTP — reconciled (ok); model range/cursor/scale/edge ok; artifact self-report pass; OBSERVED (not scored): 0 effective-edge row(s) and 0 convergence point(s) sit exactly on theory, and runsZ is nonzero — all legitimate outcomes under the null, reported rather than rejected; SCOPE — saved Pass-1 summaries satisfy structural consistency, integer-return reconstruction and the declared statistical screens. The original random inputs were not retained; their raw statistics cannot be replayed. npm run test:full generates a new experiment. See AUDIT_CONTEXT.md §9 and §11, L1; STATISTICAL ALLOWANCES — 7 screens across Steps 16-17: S1 Pass-1 draw uniformity χ², two-sided (upper: non-uniform; lower: too uniform) [α/3 = 3.333e-3]; S2 Pass-1 lag-1 autocorrelation |z| vs the two-sided critical z [α/3 = 3.333e-3]; S3 Pass-1 Wald–Wolfowitz runs test, two-sided [α/3 = 3.333e-3]; S4 nine effective-edge bands, each |simRTP − theory| ≤ 5·SE + 1e-4 [≈5.73e-7 per band, ≈5.16e-6 over nine]; S5 RTP-convergence final point within 5·SE + 1e-4 of theory [≈5.73e-7]; S6 cherry-pick flag count, exact one-sided binomial [≤ α = 0.01 (discrete, achieved size below α)]; S7 pooled real-roll uniformity χ², one-sided upper tail [α = 0.01]. S1-S3 use Bonferroni at α=0.01; the combined nominal allowance is ≈0.0100057 for Step 16 and ≈0.0300 across both steps. Chi-squared and normal components use asymptotic reference distributions; these are not measured finite-sample failure frequencies. Deterministic reconciliation checks are separate.
